description: Implementation of the du_cell_stop_procedure class, managing the stopping of a cell, releasing UEs, and handling asynchronous operations related to cell shutdown in a 5G/telecom context.

classes.name: du_cell_stop_procedure
classes.description: Class responsible for stopping a cell, releasing associated UEs, and managing related asynchronous procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine to stop the cell, release UEs, and ensure proper shutdown sequence.

methods.name: force_ue_removal
methods.description: Forces removal of UEs associated with the cell, optionally triggering F1 reset.

methods.name: rem_ues_with_matching_pcell
methods.description: Handles UEs release process, either via CU request or direct reset.

methods.name: await_cu_to_release_ues
methods.description: Waits for UEs to be released by the CU, with timeout and fallback to force removal.
